name: Chorus Leader Beryl

intro.text: Kick it off, throw it in, have a little scrimmage! You want the Chorus's blessing? You'll have to out-sing us. And out-battle us. Mainly out-battle us.

win: Well, I'll be. You've a voice on you like a Norwich canary.
after: Go on back to the Kit Man and give him the words, all of them, mind. Never mind the danger.
